text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
@Gideon Sato: you first reported it at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. You wrote that both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. The times in the channel have no timezone shown. Your message today is in -05:00, so I'd read them as Hartford local time.

The guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard from at least your 10:42 report. The channel has no record of what the guard was doing before that.

- **11:03 AM:** Mateo posted that kiosk 1 was back. The guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
- **11:07 AM:** You posted both lanes working as of 11:07. That is about 25 minutes after your first report.
- **Context:** Mateo reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44 AM. The related ticket is INC-4821.

The channel doesn't say when kiosk 2 recovered. It also doesn't say when the outage actually began, so the 10:42 report may be later than the real start.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: @Ruth Calloway: INC-4821. Gideon wrote in this channel on 3 Aug at 11:08 AM that the status-page screenshot is attached to that ticket. That was while he was still chasing the access problem that Mateo reported at 10:44 AM.
